# ui::ClipboardContentOptions

Header: `winui/ui/Clipboard.hpp`.

Whether content may be kept in the clipboard history (Win+V) and synced to the user's other devices. Both default to allowed. Each only matters while the user has that feature turned on.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `is_allowed_in_history` | `bool` | `true` | May appear in the Win+V clipboard history. |
| `is_roamable` | `bool` | `true` | May sync to the user's other devices. |
